sql: select i.unit, i.phone_number, b.test_mode_enabled, b.follow_up_enabled, b.follow_up_delay_hours, left(b.follow_up_message,220) m1, b.follow_up_2_enabled, b.follow_up_2_delay_hours, left(b.follow_up_2_message,220) m2, b.follow_up_3_enabled, b.follow_up_3_delay_hours, left(b.follow_up_3_message,220) m3, b.follow_up_4_enabled, b.follow_up_4_delay_hours, left(b.follow_up_4_message,220) m4, b.follow_up_min_hour, b.follow_up_max_hour, b.auto_lost_enabled, b.auto_lost_delay_hours, b.next_step_reminder_enabled, b.next_step_reminder_delay_minutes, b.bot_inactive_followup_enabled, b.bot_inactive_followup_delay_minutes, left(b.bot_inactive_followup_message,220) mi from public.wapi_bot_settings b join public.wapi_instances i on i.id = b.instance_id where i.company_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'
